note: It says 'God created the heavens and the earth.' It specifically says heavens meaning God created many heavens and one earth.
author: tinomazorodze

questions.question: What are the many heavens that God created?
questions.author: tinomazorodze

answers.answer: I think the heavens meant in this context are the sky, outer space and the spiritual realm (paradise).
answers.author: tinomazorodze

note: It says 'Let us make mankind': The use of the word 'us' implies plural unlike the previous verses which appeared singular.
author: tinomazorodze

questions.question: Who is the 'us' that is being referred to in this verse?
questions.author: tinomazorodze

answers.answer: I think us is referring to the Trinity (Father, Son and Holy Spirit) as they were all involved in the creation of mankind.
answers.author: tinomazorodze

note: it goes on to say 'in our image, in our likeness': This implies that mankind was created in the image and likeness of God
author: tinomazorodze

questions.question: What is this likeness or image of God being meant?
questions.author: tinomazorodze

answers.answer: I think it refers to mankind having a similar trinity nature just as God is 3 in 1 (The Father, The Son, The Holy Spirit) mankind is 3 in 1 (body, soul, spirit).
answers.author: tinomazorodze
